headline: UN Inter-Agency Task Force on NCDs holds 27th meeting at WHO in Geneva
dek: A WHO technical officer said the meeting underlined that much NCD prevention lies outside the health sector and requires several agencies to work together.
body:
The UN Inter-Agency Task Force on NCDs held its 27th meeting at WHO headquarters in Geneva this week, according to Dr Alexey Kulikov, a Technical Officer in the WHO Department of NCDs and Mental Health. He wrote on X on 20 November that agencies took part both in the room and online.

Dr Kulikov said that what struck him again was "how much of preventing NCDs noncommunicable diseases happens outside the health sector". He listed tax policy, farming, food systems, city planning, clean air and workplace practices as examples.

He said no single agency holds all of these levers, which is why a number of organisations work on them jointly. He named the WHO Framework Convention on Tobacco Control (FCTC) secretariat, UNDP, UN-Habitat, UN Nutrition, UNICEF and WHO, along with "many others".

Dr Kulikov also shared the first of two videos from the meeting, which focuses on prevention. He said the second, covering care, resources and countries, will follow.
